newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: DIARY-AUSTRALIAN STATISTICS SCHEDULE TO END OCT.
newsitem.headline: DIARY-AUSTRALIAN STATISTICS SCHEDULE TO END OCT.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics has scheduled the following figures for release to end-September. Data are issued at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT).
For forecasts, see the weekly Consensus report for Australian indicators (Key AU/ECI f9).
Aug 14 - Average weekly earnings, final data, May quarter
Aug 28 - Private New Capital Expenditure, June quarter
Aug 29 - International Trade in Goods and Services, July
- Stocks, Selected Industry Sales, June quarter
Sep 04 - House Price Indexes, June quarter
- Indexes of Industrial Production, June quarter
Sep 25 - Job Vacancies and Overtime, August quarter
Sep 26 - New Motor Vehicle Registrations, August
Sep 29 - International Trade in Goods and Services, August
Oct 20 - Manufacturing Output Prices, September quarter
- Housing materials price index, September quarter
- Building materials price index, September quarter
Oct 21 - Manufacturing Input Prices, September quarter
Oct 22 - Consumer Price Index, September quarter
Oct 23 - Average weekly earnings, August quarter
Oct 30 - International Trade in Goods and Services, Sept
